title: SkillFrontmatter
description: Structured frontmatter block for a Skill Document. The full Skill Document is a Markdown file beginning with a `---`-fenced YAML block matching this schema, followed by free-form Markdown body. See docs/skills/README.md.

name.description: Kebab-case stable id; doubles as filename and lookup key.

version.description: Semantic version of the skill content.

description.description: One-line summary fed to the LLM during retrieval.

triggers.description: Phrases the curator/router matches user intent against.

tools.description: Names from ToolRegistry this skill expects to use.

inputs.description: Declared inputs the skill expects (name -> human description).

author.description: Optional human or agent author label.
